question: What is the molecular target of tocilizumab ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Tocilizumab -> binds to Interleukin 6 receptor -> inhibits Interleukin 6 signaling -> 95% CHAIN: Tocilizumab -> blocks the action of Interleukin 6 -> reduces inflammation -> 90% CHAIN: Tocilizumab -> targets Interleukin 6 receptor -> decreases acute-phase reactants -> 95%
